[[Ogre-Slaying Knife]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[The_Darkness (boss)|The Darknesses]] that can be found in the [[The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 1-4 
:Damage: +9 (vs. [[Ogre]]s)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated by any means.

==Notes==
*The "''+9 (vs. Ogres)''" [[upgrade]] is unique. Normally, an "''of <Creature> slaying''" [[suffix]] increases the percentile damage up to 20%; this one adds damage points.
*This is the smallest sword skin in the game.
*Other items with this appearance:
**{{n}} [[Blood Knife]]
**{{n}} [[Grim Cesta (knife)]]
**{{n}} [[Idol (knife)]]
*[[Shattered Illusion]] is another weapon that uses the skin of a focus item.

==Trivia==
* This item is a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Dungeons & Dragons|Dungeons & Dragons]] comedy audio skit performed by the Dead Alewives Club. The +9 is in reference to the skit and the damage is equal to that of a dagger in the game.
